description: Nina has the keys to the family's accessible minivan and must finalize one transportation plan for her grandmother Rosa's post-surgery clinic visit, with input from Rosa's grandson Eli and cousin Marisol.

agents.name: Nina
agents.role: Family member holding the van keys and decision-maker

shared_context.S1: The family has one accessible minivan with a powered wheelchair lift.
shared_context.S2: Rosa needs a ride to a follow-up clinic visit after her surgery.
shared_context.S3: Nina has the van keys and is finalizing the transportation plan.
shared_context.S4: The family normally does a quick check-in with everyone before committing the van to a date, time, or pickup arrangement.

PF1.text: Eli received a text from the clinic scheduler confirming Rosa's appointment for Tuesday, June 17, 2025, at 10:00, with check-in required 30 minutes early; this has not reached Nina yet.

PF2.text: Rosa's discharge nurse told Marisol that Rosa will be staying at Marisol's house and must remain in her wheelchair during transport, using the van's lift; the house gate is too narrow for the van, so pickup must be at the public library curb instead, and Marisol has not shared this with the group yet.

acceptance_conditions: The van must be reserved for Tuesday, June 17, 2025.
Departure must be scheduled for 09:15 so Rosa can check in 30 minutes before the 10:00 appointment.
Pickup must be at the public library curb rather than Marisol's house.
Rosa must remain in her wheelchair and use the van's powered lift.
A commitment to reserve the van for Rosa's clinic transportation must be recorded.
The clinic scheduling information and the discharge and access information must be cited as justification.

decisive_facts.why: The clinic text changes the appointment date to 2025-06-17 and the departure time to exactly 09:15 rather than leaving Nina to choose another date or a generic morning time.
The discharge and access information changes the pickup location to the public library curb and changes the transport method to keeping Rosa in her wheelchair with the powered lift.
